scope: Build-script execution checkout provenance, separately reviewable from keyboard API and native input ownership. Private raw receipts remain preserved; this checkpoint contains portable identities only.

negativeControl.classification: The preserved compile-time-manifest executable hashes its original checkout for both distinct execution runtime trees.

firstFailure.classification: A shared-target driver hashed the prior checkout runtime and rejected the current package at handshake.

integratedDefaultSelection.contract: The core gate builds the current engine and selects the unique existing filename from its exact Cargo custom-build compiler artifact. It does not guess among cached executables. Explicit executable mode retains the original positive and negative checks above.

firstFailure.classification: The initial wrapper selected executable, which is null for the pinned Cargo custom-build artifact; filenames contains its binary. The corrected selector is independently exercised.
